answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because hollow only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, atlas is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any marble approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
